setting-feed-growth-per-day: Feed Modifier Growth per day (if conditions are met)
setting-feed-decay-per-day: Feed Modifier Decay per day (if conditions are not met)
setting-feed-good-weight-threshold: Good Weight threshold (Feed modifier will grow)
setting-feed-ok-weight-threshold: Ok Weight threshold (Feed modifier will stay the same)
setting-interact-growth-per-day: Interact Modifier Growth per day (if conditions are met)
setting-interact-decay-per-day: Interact Modifier Decay (if conditions are not met)
setting-interact-grace-days: Amount of days after interaction before decay begins
setting-interact-generation-decay-multip: Multiplier to multiply generation by to determine how often decay is checked
